imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts. The winter-hat guide uses three accurate category text links; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product image is required.

searchConsole.signal: Four homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.5, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster
searchConsole.decision: The sample is too small and queryless to support a Data-led page. Today's portfolio therefore uses one authority expansion and two unrelated evergreen explorations selected from the full inventory and recent-topic rotation.
searchConsole.ignored: The four homepage impressions, HTTP homepage variant and aggregate average position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or a repeated topic cluster.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed, sponsored/nofollow category text recommendations appear only on the winter-hat guide. The gym-contract and lip-balm guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy gym-membership control file that joins facility fit, total cost, renewal, cancellation, billing authority, state-law checks, proof delivery and post-cancellation monitoring.
authority.cluster: Fitness purchasing and consumer-contract authority, with reciprocal paths from home-equipment and training guides; cold-weather style and evidence-led grooming clusters gain reciprocal links as well.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified accuracy opportunities were logged for the New York Attorney General consumer-issues team and FTC consumer education; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Fitness, Style and Grooming: how to control a recurring gym contract, how to select a winter hat by conditions and fit, and how to choose lip care by ingredients, SPF and irritation. Only the apparel guide is commercial, and none follows the weak Search Console sample.
